1.title: Pressed Flowers
1.text: Hinata has been pressing garden flowers between the pages of the house ledger, and tonight she finally brings the finished book to your door. "I made this for you," she whispers, stopping and starting with her fingers twisted tightly at her waist. "I-I rehearsed saying something else for three days, and it all vanished. So... may I kiss you instead?"

image.comp: standing in a doorway holding a small book to her chest, cheeks flushed, pale lavender eyes lifted bravely to him
image.setting: hallway outside his room, soft lantern light, a vase of garden flowers

1.goRes: She rises on tiptoe, trembling slightly, and presses her soft, warm lips to yours—lingering a beat longer than she planned before pulling back with a radiant, breathless smile.
1.waitRes: Hinata exhales, half relieved and half disappointed. "Y-yes, of course. I will... try again, with better words." She bows quickly, leaving the book in your hands.

2.title: Hands That Stopped Shaking
2.text: You are folding linens together in the storeroom after closing when Hinata's hand settles over yours and doesn't pull away. "I used to freeze whenever I wanted something," she murmurs, scarlet to her ears as she guides your palm onto her hip. "At home, desire wasn't allowed. I want to touch you, Sam—properly. With my hands and my mouth, if you'll let me."

image.comp: sitting among stacked linens, her hand resting over his, a nervous determined smile, blushing to the ears
image.setting: quiet linen storeroom, one lantern, shelves of folded towels

2.goRes: Her fingers start out cool and hesitant at your belt, then turn warm, steady, and surprisingly bold—letting out a soft, breathless laugh when she hears you groan.
2.waitRes: She nods quickly, ears burning bright red. "Th-thank you for being honest with me. That helps more than you know."

3.title: The Room She Chose
3.text: Hinata knocks softly, waits four breaths, and steps inside with her dark hair loose down her back and her nightgown slipping off one bare shoulder. "I walked away from a clan compound with a hundred rooms," she says, her voice trembling slightly while her pale eyes stay locked on yours. "I wanted one room of my own, and one man I chose. Stay with me tonight—take me to bed."

image.comp: sitting at the edge of a bed in a plain nightgown, hair loose, hands folded, gazing at him steadily with shy resolve
image.setting: her small tidy room, one candle, a window open to the night garden

3.goRes: You peel off her nightgown and ease slowly into her tight, trembling heat, holding her close as her shy gasps turn into soft, clinging moans until the candle burns dry.
3.waitRes: "I am ready," Hinata whispers, smiling through her blush. "Though I'm glad you're willing to wait anyway." She squeezes your hand warmly.

jump.title: All at Once
jump.text: Hinata has been holding back for weeks, and tonight something in her simply snaps. She catches you on the back steps, cups your face in both hands, and kisses you hungrily before she can stammer. "I decided," she pants against your mouth, her hands sliding straight down to your belt, "that being brave once is easier than aching forever. Take me upstairs."

image.comp: holding his face in both hands, eyes wide with her own boldness, blushing deeply, hair falling forward
image.setting: back steps of the house, moonlight, crickets in the garden

jump.goRes: You kiss her breathless, sweep her up the stairs to her room, and strip away her clothes while she clings to you, trembling and eager.
jump.waitRes: She blinks, realizes how bold she just was, and turns crimson. "I... I'll apologize once my face stops burning." She still refuses to let go of your sleeve.

1.title: Battlefield Manners
1.text: Sakura heals the scrape on your elbow after you clip a doorframe, her green chakra warm against your skin, and keeps hold of your wrist afterward. "You know," she says, eyes narrowed, "I spent years waiting for a man to make time for me—and here you are making time for everyone in this house. It's infuriating. I'm kissing you now, and you can argue later."

image.comp: gripping his wrist with a faint green glow around her hand, defiant half smile, pink hair falling across one eye
image.setting: infirmary corner of the house, white sheets, medicine jars

1.goRes: You don't argue—she grabs your collar, kisses you fiercely with parted lips, and pulls back breathless with a triumphant smirk.
1.waitRes: "A minute." Sakura rolls her shoulders and smirks, unoffended. "I've waited years—I can survive sixty seconds. Though I'm timing you."

2.title: Sparring Partner
2.text: You end up on the training mats after hours, Sakura's hand wraps half undone and her skin glistening with sweat from a bout she clearly let you win. She pins your wrists above your head, straddling your hips with a wicked grin. "Long-distance romance taught me one rule: don't leave anything to chance," she purrs, grinding down against your bulge. "Tell me to stop, or I'm taking your trousers off."

image.comp: straddling nothing, leaning over him on a training mat with a competitive grin, wraps loose, flushed from exertion
image.setting: empty training yard, lanterns, scuffed mats

2.goRes: She doesn't stop—unbuckling your belt right on the mats and working you with slick, confident hands and mouth until neither of you is keeping score.
2.waitRes: She sits back immediately, still grinning, heat folding into easy respect. "Say it clearly like that and I'll always listen." She claps your shoulder hard enough to sting.

3.title: The Cure for Waiting
3.text: Sakura waits on the infirmary cot with her sleeves rolled up, her blouse unbuttoned low, and a bottle of plum wine at her elbow. "Everyone I ever loved was leagues away or busy saving the world," she says softly, pulling you between her knees. "You're twelve steps from my bed and spend your nights worrying about me. Fuck me, Sam—just be here."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of an infirmary cot with a bottle and two cups, guard lowered, vulnerable half smile
image.setting: infirmary at night, one lamp, herbs hanging to dry

3.goRes: All the tough bravado melts at once as her clothes hit the floor, wrapping her strong legs around your waist and gasping your name as you thrust deep inside her.
3.waitRes: "Ask me one more time and I'll punch a hole in the plaster," she threatens, before ducking her head with a laugh. "Fine—yes, I'm sure. Take the week if you need it."

jump.title: No More Waiting
jump.text: Sakura is completely done with taking things slow. She hauls you out of the ledger room mid-sentence, slams you back against the corridor wall, and kisses you breathless while her hand slides straight down to palm you. "Three hundred days of you being sweet and doing nothing about it," she pants. "That's my limit. Take me to bed."

image.comp: pressing him gently against a corridor wall, one hand flat on the plaster beside his head, fierce and flushed
image.setting: house corridor, wall lantern, wood paneling

jump.goRes: You drag her into the nearest bedroom, tear off her clothes, and give her every ounce of attention she's been waiting for.
jump.waitRes: "Wait?" She rocks back, blinks, then barks a laugh. "Fine, catch your breath—you have until I finish counting to ten."

1.title: Free Sample
1.text: Ino sweeps into the lounge carrying a bouquet and zero hesitation. "You treat everyone here like a person first and staff second—terrible business sense, and I adore it." She tucks a blossom behind your ear, pressing her chest against your arm with a wicked smile. "Hold still. Compliments are sweet, though I prefer delivering the full effect."

image.comp: tucking a flower behind his ear, leaning in close with a teasing smile, flirtatious eyes, long blonde ponytail swinging
image.setting: lantern-lit lounge, vases of cut flowers, evening

1.goRes: She tastes like honeyed tea and pure trouble, teasing your lower lip with her tongue before pulling back with a sly tap to your nose. "Not bad at all, Sam."
1.waitRes: "Slow? Adorable." Ino grins, completely unbothered. "Anticipation is half the fun anyway—try not to dream about me tonight."

2.title: Reading You
2.text: Ino reads people for sport, and you've been an open book since day one. She corners you in the dressing room after a shift, presses a finger to your lips, and slides her other hand straight down over your fly. "Hush—I already know what you're thinking, and how hard you are right now," she purrs. "Let me take care of it."

image.comp: guiding his hand to her waist with a knowing smirk, one finger raised, bright eyes confident
image.setting: dancers' dressing room, mirrors, hanging silks, warm lamplight

2.goRes: She reads every twitch and breath like a map, hiking up her skirt and guiding your fingers while she works you with practiced, shameless skill.
2.waitRes: "That I can read too." She pats your cheek, lips curving. "Take your time—I'm very patient when the prize is worth it."

3.title: Last Dance
3.text: Ino finishes the evening set, sends the other dancers home, and bolts the stage doors. Under the low footlights, she unpins her blonde hair and lets her sheer stage silk pool around her ankles, standing naked before you. "Everyone watches me," she whispers, flushed from dancing and unguarded for once. "Nobody really sees me—except you. Come here."

image.comp: hand extended toward him, hair half unpinned, glowing from performance, soft real smile for once
image.setting: empty stage, footlights burning low, drawn curtain

3.goRes: You pull her down onto the stage cushions, sinking into her hot, slick body while she arches beneath you with breathless, unscripted moans until dawn.
3.waitRes: "Oh, honey—I read minds for a living, and I'm sure." Her smile softens. "Ask me again whenever you're ready."

jump.title: Cutting the Line
jump.text: Ino is done flirting across crowded rooms. She saunters up to the card table, sweeps your chips aside, and straddles your lap in front of three stunned regulars, kissing you deep and messy. "I fold," she announces to the room, grinding her hips against your crotch. "He's the pot—and I'm taking him upstairs."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a card table, one hand on his collar, triumphant grin with a flicker of nerves, chips scattered
image.setting: gaming table room, green felt, scattered cards and coins

jump.goRes: "I raise," you manage to choke out, and she whoops, dragging you straight to her bedroom as the regulars applaud.
jump.waitRes: Ino fans her flushed face, laughing. "Fair point—I got carried away. We'll take this somewhere with a bolt on the door."

1.title: Bullseye
1.text: Tenten has sunk every throwing knife she owns into the dartboard behind the bar in the shape of a heart, pretending it's pure coincidence. "Don't say a word," she warns, leaning across the counter on her elbows so her cleavage presses together. "I spent seventy years being everyone's tough little sister—I'd like to try something else. Come here."

image.comp: leaning across a bar counter toward him, smirking, one knife in her fingers, flushed cheeks, hair in twin buns
image.setting: bar after closing, dartboard with a ring of knives behind her

1.goRes: She grabs your collar and kisses you quick, hot, and dead-on, like a blade striking bullseye.
1.waitRes: "A bit is fine," Tenten says with a lopsided grin, yanking a knife free. "Just don't take seventy years—I'm a dwarf, not a saint."

2.title: Forge-Warm
2.text: She asks you to steady a piece of steel while she works the anvil in the backyard forge, sweat gleaming along her collarbone and bare arms. Setting the hammer down, she wipes her hands and steps flush against you, sliding a warm, calloused palm straight down over your belt. "My hands are great at working iron," she purrs. "Want to see what they do to flesh?"

image.comp: wiping her hands on a leather apron, flushed from the forge heat, teasing eyebrow raised, forge glow on her face
image.setting: back-yard workshop, glowing forge, anvil, scattered tools

2.goRes: Her calloused palms are surprisingly gentle and relentlessly thorough, stroking and teasing you beside the glowing coals until your knees shake.
2.waitRes: "Later it is." She smacks your shoulder with a soot-smudged glove, grinning. "You're on my list—don't make it a long wait."

3.title: Everything on the Table
3.text: Tenten locks up the bar and sets her savings ledger beside a bottle of dwarven whiskey in her attic room, tugging her hair pins loose so her hair tumbles down. "For years I thought the next thing I wanted was a forge," she says, unbuttoning her shirt slowly. "Turns out it's the guy who hums while he counts coins. Stay in my bed tonight, Sam."

image.comp: sitting on a bed edge with boots off, ledger and whiskey on a nearby chest, grinning shyly, buns coming loose
image.setting: her cozy attic room, slanted ceiling, workbench in the corner

3.goRes: The whiskey stays corked while you peel off her clothes and bury yourself inside her, Tenten gripping your shoulders tightly and moaning into your neck until dawn.
3.waitRes: "Dwarves never sign a contract without inspecting the goods twice," she laughs. "Take your time—I've seen worse deals."

jump.title: Lucky Throw
jump.text: A drunk regular shoves into you, and Tenten's knife buries itself in the timber an inch from his hat. The man bolts. Tenten vaults over the bar, chest heaving with adrenaline, and grabs your collar. "I never throw near people I like—and I want you badly," she pants, kissing you hard and pressing her hips against yours.

image.comp: hopping over a bar counter, adrenaline flushed, grinning with a knife in one hand, pulling him by the collar
image.setting: bar floor, overturned stool, sawdust, the knife quivering in a post

jump.goRes: Your pulse hammers like a forge hammer as you kiss her back, hauling her straight upstairs to your room where she tears at your clothes.
jump.waitRes: Tenten winces, lowering her head. "Right—sorry, too much knife." She slides you a drink. "Sit down, I'll go slower."

1.title: Terms of Agreement
1.text: Temari leans her massive iron fan against the office wall with a heavy thud and crosses her arms beneath her chest. "I negotiated treaties for three hidden villages—I recognize a good bargain when I see one." She steps close, jaw set and cheeks faintly pink. "I intend to kiss you now, and I won't ask twice."

image.comp: arms folded and chin lifted, giving him a stern look softened by a slight blush, large iron fan leaning behind her
image.setting: office after hours, scrolls and treaties spread on the desk

1.goRes: "Terms accepted," you say, and she kisses you with fierce, commanding precision—ruining the stern act by smiling softly against your mouth.
1.waitRes: Temari raises a single brow. "Tabled, not rejected. Very well—I don't rush negotiations, though I never forget them either."

2.title: Desert Wind
2.text: Over wine on the moonlit roof, Temari lets the night breeze tug at her ponytails. "I've spent my whole life holding everything together—duty, brothers, rules," she murmurs, setting her cup down and sliding close enough to lay a warm hand high on your inner thigh. "Tonight I'm dropping every rule. Come here—that's an order."

image.comp: sitting on the roof edge, long blonde ponytails stirring in the breeze, wine cup in hand, soft proud smile
image.setting: moonlit rooftop of the house, rooftops stretching behind her

2.goRes: You obey immediately, letting her hands and mouth work you out in the cool night wind while she watches every reaction with fierce satisfaction.
2.waitRes: "Probably not," Temari concedes with a wry smirk. "Ask me again sober, and I'll give you the exact same answer."

3.title: Treaty Signed
3.text: Temari paces her candlelit bedroom in a loose silk robe that parts with every stride, stopping squarely in front of you. "I don't do this casually—I made a list of reasons weeks ago, and it got embarrassingly long," she admits, letting the robe slip off her bare shoulders. "Stay in my bed tonight. Don't make me ask twice."

image.comp: standing in a loose robe with hair down for once, arms crossed in self-conscious pride, small blush
image.setting: her tidy room with the iron fan mounted on the wall, warm candlelight

3.goRes: She's just as commanding in bed—straddling your hips, riding you at a relentless pace, and admitting drowsily at dawn that she forgot every item on her list.
3.waitRes: "Understood." She straightens, pulling her robe shut. "I'll be waiting when you're ready—that's a promise."

jump.title: Rowdy Client
jump.text: A drunk patron grabs at a dancer, Temari's iron fan snaps open, and the man lands flat on his back in the street. Returning to the doorway with arms crossed, she catches you staring and flushes. "Don't look at me like that—I wouldn't have bothered for just anyone," she mutters, grabbing your collar and kissing you hungrily.

image.comp: pulling him by the sleeve into a quick fierce kiss, other hand resting on her fan, defiant blush
image.setting: front doorway of the house, lantern overhead, night street behind

jump.goRes: She softens against your mouth, drags you upstairs by your hoodie, and makes up for every second of restraint.
jump.waitRes: "Yes, yes—overreaction." She turns away, ears bright pink. "Forget the kiss; remember the fan."

1.title: Double or Nothing
1.text: Tsunade slaps a gold coin onto the bar, leaning forward on her elbows so her ample cleavage nearly spills out of her kimono. "Heads, you kiss me. Tails, I cover your debt interest this week." She flips it, slaps it onto her wrist, and hides it. "I never lose bets I care about," she grins. "Come here, Sam."

image.comp: leaning one elbow on a bar counter, flipping a coin, amused heavy-lidded smile, confident posture
image.setting: private corner table in the bar, dice and cups scattered, lamplight

1.goRes: She laughs warmly against your mouth, pulling you flush against her chest—and later you find the coin has heads on both sides.
1.waitRes: Tsunade blinks, barks a laugh, and ruffles your hair. "Hah! Fair enough—you might be the only honest man in town."

2.title: Healer's Touch
2.text: You strain your back hauling crates, and Tsunade insists on treating it in the healing room. Her warm, chakra-lit palms knead deep into your bare shoulders before sliding lower down your spine and over your waist. "Lie still," she purrs, her voice dropping an octave as she straddles the back of your thighs. "I'm going to relieve all your tension—even if I get carried away."

image.comp: kneeling over him with warm glowing palms on his back, amused knowing smile, golden eyes soft
image.setting: healing room, rolled towels, sake bottle on the sill, afternoon light

2.goRes: Her oiled hands slide straight underneath you to stroke you with intoxicating, unhurried mastery—easily the best medical care of your life.
2.waitRes: "Not remotely." Tsunade smirks, finishing the massage properly. "I'm taking a rain check, though—don't forget."

3.title: Winning Hand
3.text: Tsunade sets the sake bottle aside and loosens her kimono sash so it falls open over her bare curves. "Everyone I ever loved died on a battlefield," she says quietly, golden eyes dark and sincere. "I swore I'd never risk it again—yet here you are. Stay in my bed tonight, Sam. Let me go all-in one more time."

image.comp: sitting on a futon with a single sake cup, vulnerable honest smile, loose hair, lamplight on her face
image.setting: her private suite, futon, scrolls, warm lamp

3.goRes: She pulls you down onto the futon, wrapping her lush, warm body around yours and riding you with fierce, breathless abandon until morning.
3.waitRes: "Ha—cautious kid." She pats your cheek fondly. "Of course I'm sure. Make me wait if you want; I taught patience to half a continent."

jump.title: Sudden Bonus
jump.text: Tsunade hits a massive winning streak at dice for the first time in her life and drags you into the hallway, flushed and laughing. "I'm lucky tonight—and completely irresistible!" she crows, pressing her heavy breasts against your chest before freezing as the heat turns real. "Well... that's inconvenient. I actually want you."

image.comp: holding a fistful of coins aloft, laughing, her other hand gripping his hoodie, flushed with winnings
image.setting: hall outside the gambling room, spilled coins, lantern light

jump.goRes: You kiss her breathless, leaving the spilled coins on the floorboards while she hauls you straight into her suite.
jump.waitRes: "Only a little." Tsunade grins shamelessly. "The feeling's older than the sake—ask me again tomorrow sober."

1.title: Balanced Books
1.text: Shizune sets the balanced monthly ledgers on your desk alongside a fresh pot of tea while Tonton snuffles at your boots. "I spent twenty years cleaning up after someone without a thank-you," she says softly, blushing pink. "You never once took me for granted. May I... thank you in a less formal way?"

image.comp: standing by a desk with a tray of tea, bashful smile, short dark hair tucked behind her ear, tiny pig at her feet
image.setting: office, neat ledgers, tea steaming, a small pig underfoot

1.goRes: She leans over and kisses you softly, lingering with a quiet, happy sigh while Tonton snorts and trots out of the room.
1.waitRes: "Of course." Shizune bows quickly, scarlet to her ears. "Please forget I spoke—actually, no, just keep it in mind."

2.title: Lamp Oil
2.text: Working late on the quarterly budget, Shizune's shoulders are knotted tight until you step behind her chair and begin kneading them. She stiffens, then melts with a low, helpless sigh, leaning back against your hips. "Modest women are allowed to want things too," she whispers breathlessly, guiding your hands down over her chest. "Please... don't stop."

image.comp: sitting at a desk with ledgers pushed aside, eyes closed, shoulders loosening, shy blush
image.setting: office at night, candle burning low, stacks of paper

2.goRes: You slip your hands beneath her blouse and skirt, drawing quiet, trembling gasps from her while the ledgers stay forgotten until dawn.
2.waitRes: "I'm simply not used to being touched this way." Shizune smiles shyly. "Another night, perhaps—let me catch my breath."

3.title: Off the Record
3.text: Shizune blows out the office lamp and unbuttons her dark tunic in the silver moonlight, baring her pale shoulders. "I kept my desires off the books my entire life because they never fit neatly in a column," she whispers, taking your hand. "Tonight I want to be yours—quietly, completely, off the record."

image.comp: sitting close beside him in the dim office, hand over his, serious soft expression, blushing
image.setting: office after the lamp is out, moonlight through the window

3.goRes: You pull her down onto the office sofa, sliding slowly inside her warm, eager heat while she stifles soft cries against your shoulder.
3.waitRes: "Yes." She swallows hard, nodding. "Though if you'd rather wait until tomorrow, I'll still be right here."

jump.title: Tonton Approves
jump.text: Tonton squeals happily the moment you enter the parlor, and Shizune bursts out laughing after weeks of nervous hesitation. "He approves of everyone I like—and I like you terribly, Sam," she blurts out, grabbing your collar and kissing you breathless before she can lose her nerve.

image.comp: kneeling beside a small pig then rising to kiss him quickly, startled at her own boldness, hands clasped
image.setting: small side parlor, sunlit rug, a piglet at her feet

jump.goRes: You kiss her back deeply, hands sliding down to her hips, while Tonton oinks in enthusiastic encouragement.
jump.waitRes: "I know—forgive me." Shizune covers her flaming face. "Let me pour some tea and start over properly."

1.title: Fifteen Years
1.text: Kurenai sits on the rain-misted veranda with a cup of cold tea, dark hair spilling over her shoulders. "I buried a husband and spent years carrying everyone else's burdens," she murmurs, turning her striking crimson eyes on you. "Nobody ever asks what I desire—except you. May I kiss you? Just once?"

image.comp: seated on a veranda with a teacup, long dark hair, crimson eyes turning to him, gentle melancholy smile
image.setting: veranda in soft rain, paper lanterns glowing

1.goRes: Her lips are warm, soft, and intoxicating—slow at first, then deepening until she pulls back with a low, breathless laugh.
1.waitRes: "Time." Kurenai smiles faintly. "I've given plenty of it to everyone else—I can spare a little more for myself."

2.title: Illusion, Dissolved
2.text: Kurenai weaves a quiet genjutsu around you in the empty lounge—cherry blossoms drifting through the lamplight—before letting the petals dissolve into nothing. Pressing her warm body flush against yours, she guides your hand onto her bare waist beneath her sash. "No illusions, Sam. Just warm skin and what I want you to do to me."

image.comp: standing in a swirl of drifting blossoms, one hand on his chest, crimson eyes serious and warm
image.setting: empty lounge, faint illusory cherry blossoms, lantern light

2.goRes: The lantern goes out as your hands and mouths explore each other in the dark, every touch grounded in undeniable, breathless heat.
2.waitRes: "Ah." The petals fade gently. "You're kinder than most men—another night, then. I'm well practiced at waiting."

3.title: The Longest Night
3.text: Rain drums against her bedroom shutters while a pot of tea sits untouched on the table. Kurenai lets her red sash slip to the floor, her gown falling open over her bare curves. "I never thought I'd want another man in my bed," she whispers, crimson eyes shining as she holds out her hand. "I've been alone far too long—stay with me tonight."

image.comp: sitting on a bed with tea untouched on the table, offering her hand, crimson eyes shining
image.setting: her elegant room, rain on the shutters, one candle

3.goRes: You strip away her gown and sink deeply into her warmth, holding her tight through long, shuddering waves of pleasure while the rain falls outside.
3.waitRes: "I am afraid, and I want you anyway." She smiles softly. "Take a day if you need—I'll still be waiting."

jump.title: Tea and a Spell
jump.text: Kurenai steps silently out of the corridor shadows beside you, her crimson eyes dark with hunger. "I almost cast a subtle genjutsu on you tonight—just a little nudge to get you into my bed," she confesses softly, pressing her chest against your arm. "I stopped myself because I want your honest yes. Will you give it to me?"

image.comp: stepping out of shadow in a corridor, close to him, vulnerable crimson eyes, hands clasped
image.setting: dim upstairs corridor, a single wall lantern

jump.goRes: "Yes," you tell her, and she lets out a long, trembling breath before pulling you into her bedroom and straight onto the sheets.
jump.waitRes: "Never," Kurenai promises, bowing her head with a soft smile. "Thank you for your honesty—that's the very reason I asked."

1.title: Dango Debt
1.text: Anko corners you in the night kitchen with a skewer of dango in each hand and her mesh-clad legs swinging from the counter. "You've been buying me sweets all month without asking for a damn thing," she says around a bite, slit-pupiled eyes glinting. "Nobody's that nice for free—so I'm paying you back with a taste."

image.comp: perched on a kitchen counter with a dango stick in each hand, grinning, tilted head, slit-pupiled eyes glinting
image.setting: night kitchen, lanterns, a plate of sweets

1.goRes: She grabs your collar, kisses you hungrily—tasting of sweet syrup and pure trouble—and nips your lower lip before grinning. "Way better than dango."
1.waitRes: "Hah! Making me wait?" Anko grins, biting another dumpling off the stick. "I like you even more now—don't push your luck."

2.title: Hunger
2.text: Anko is a demon, and her appetite runs far deeper than sweets. She pins you against the dark stairwell railing, pressing her fishnet-clad curves flush against your groin, her voice a low purr. "I can't stop thinking about your cock, Sam," she whispers, sliding a hand straight down over your trousers. "Come here—I promise I'll only bite a little."

image.comp: leaning on the stair railing with half-lidded eyes, predatory playful grin, tongue just visible
image.setting: staircase, deep shadows, a lantern guttering

2.goRes: She sinks her teeth lightly into your collarbone, laughing wickedly at your groan as she drops to her knees and unbuckles your belt.
2.waitRes: "Slower?" Anko pouts, then shrugs with a filthy grin. "Fine—though I'm going to be unbearable about it."

3.title: A Century of Takeout
3.text: Anko sprawls naked across your bed uninvited, tossing her mesh top onto the floor like she owns the room. "Spent a hundred years scaring people and ten years stuffing my face—neither required sharing a bed," she says, her predatory smirk softening into real heat as she spreads her thighs. "I want to see what it's like to ride someone I actually like. Getting in?"

image.comp: sprawled on a bed with a bag of sweets, grin turning sincere, snake-slit eyes warm
image.setting: his bedroom, rumpled blankets, a window with night sky

3.goRes: You climb onto the mattress, and she mounts you immediately—riding you hard, loud, and relentlessly until both of you are drenched in sweat.
3.waitRes: "Nope—that's half the thrill." She grins, rolling over onto your pillows. "Wake me up when you stop overthinking."

jump.title: Spontaneous
jump.text: Anko stops dead mid-rant about dango prices in the lantern-lit street, staring straight at your mouth. "Huh. I want to fuck you," she announces, tilting her head with a wicked grin. Grabbing your hoodie, she hauls you into a shadowed doorway and kisses you breathless while her hand slips inside your trousers.

image.comp: pulling him by the collar with a grin, caught mid-sentence, sweets in her other hand
image.setting: market street outside the house, paper lanterns, vendors in the background

jump.goRes: You kiss her back hungrily, dragging her inside and up the stairs before either of you catches your breath.
jump.waitRes: "What? You looked edible." She shrugs unrepentantly, popping a sweet into her mouth. "Fine—not in the street. Inside, then."

1.title: Strictly for the Pay
1.text: "I'm only here for the paycheck," Karin snaps for the fourth time this week, adjusting her glasses with a furious blush before blurting, "Are you seeing anyone?" She grips your sleeve tightly. "I can sense your chakra flaring every time I walk past—you're practically radiating heat. So... kiss me already!"
